text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact was injured during practice, 
so I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'm terribly sorry. 
If only my senses had been sharper...
choice_data_list: You don't need to apologize, Tact.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Tore-san... Thank you. 
You're right, of course. No amount of 
regretting it 
will change what's already happened.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
In that case, the only thing to do 
is work as hard as I can with what I can 
do now...!
choice_data_list: Don't push yourself. Just rest for now.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: No, I can't do that...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I've seen it happen time and time again. 
Those who couldn't keep up with the herd 
due to an injury, 
left behind to fend for themselves—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
If I stop moving forward, the same will 
happen to me...
choice_data_list:
...Then let's take it step by step and see 
how it goes.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
If I stop moving forward, the same will 
happen to me...
choice_data_list:
...Then let's take it step by step and see 
how it goes.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: —Hehe, you're right. Of course you are.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Worrying about being left behind was 
baseless, wasn't it? 
After all, I have you beside me, Tore-san, 
sharing the very same dream.
choice_data_list:
Let's overcome this injury and become even 
stronger!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes! And to do that, I'll focus 
entirely on recovery for now.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much...! 
Well then, let's resume our training.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—I'm sorry. It seems training like this 
was still too much for me right now.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for being so stubborn. 
Just as you said, Tore-san, 
I'll focus entirely on resting and 
healing.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hoping with all my heart that once this 
harsh season ends, 
spring will finally arrive...

However, Daring Tact's injury proved slow 
to heal, 
and her recovery ended up taking quite 
some time.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Okay, I'm fine. 
It looks like I can keep going without any 
trouble.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...—! 
Yes, thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Tore-san. 
I promise I won't push myself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
So please, could we try some other 
low-impact exercises?

Daring Tact focused on exercises that put 
minimal strain 
on her injury, eventually making a smooth 
and steady recovery.
